name: exam_results
description: A candidate's exam results for a series, sent to the pupil and their contacts once the results are released.
subject: Exam results: {pupil_name} - {series_name}
body: Here are {pupil_first_name}'s results for the {series_name} exams at {school_name}.

If you would like a review of marking or a clerical re-check, please contact {officer_name} as soon as possible - the boards' deadlines are short, and a review can lower a grade as well as raise it, so we need the candidate's written consent.
Congratulations on all the hard work.

placeholders.pupil_name: The pupil's preferred first name and surname
placeholders.pupil_first_name: The pupil's preferred or first name
placeholders.results: The candidate number and each subject's grade
